QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_9

question.text: The SRO for Social Impact Assessors under the SEBI framework is:

answer.text: ICMAI (Institute of Cost Accountants of India)
ICSI (Institute of Company Secretaries of India)
ICAI (Institute of Chartered Accountants of India) through the Social Impact Assessment Standards Board (SIAB)
SEBI itself through a dedicated Impact-Assessor division

explanation.text: **The Logic:** ICAI is the notified SRO for SIAs, operating through its Social Impact Assessment Standards Board (SIAB) which drafts the SAS-100 through SAS-1600 standards. ICMAI and ICSI members can be empanelled as SIAs but the SRO is ICAI. **The Trap:** Option A is the most common confusion — ICMAI Cost Accountants can be empanelled SIAs, but ICMAI is NOT the SRO. Options B and D are incorrect. **Cross-Exam Context:** ICAI-as-SRO also appears in X-A / X-B (Investment Adviser — where ICAI members can register as IAs) and V-A (MF Distributor — ICAI CPE cross-reference). **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** In your engagement letter, cite 'ICAI SIAB' by name and your ICAI SRO Registration Number (format: 117366W/W-18ZU8 in the Chapter 8 template) — peer reviewers flag missing SRO numbers quickly.
